seo_title: Small Arabesque Mosaic Tiles for Bathroom
meta_description: Small arabesque mosaic tiles for bathroom walls in glazed ceramic: a curved, interlocking pattern for feature walls. Free sample on WhatsApp.
description:
These arabesque mosaic tiles for bathroom walls are small glazed ceramic pieces cut in the arabesque outline, a curved, interlocking shape that tends to read as a soft, flowing pattern rather than a straight grid.

## How they look
The arabesque shape has rounded sides and pointed ends that lock into each other, so a wall of small arabesque tiles looks woven rather than gridded. The glaze gives a sealed face that catches light. Because the pieces are small, the grout lines become part of the design: a contrasting grout outlines each shape, a matching grout gives a calmer wall.

## Where they work
- **A bathroom feature wall** behind the basin, vanity or bathtub.
- **Shower walls and niches**, where a glazed surface is generally easier to wipe than unglazed clay.
- **Powder rooms**, where a small area can carry a bold pattern.

Pair a glazed ceramic arabesque mosaic wall with plain floor tiles so the pattern stays the focus.

## Good to know
- Material: glazed ceramic mosaic
- Shape: small arabesque
- Category: bathroom wall mosaic tiles
- Size and sheet layout: confirm on enquiry

Small mosaics mean many grout lines, so ask your tiler about waterproofing behind the shower, a suitable adhesive and an epoxy or water-resistant grout. Clean with a mild, non-acid cleaner.

## See it before you order
Pak Clay shows its range at the Lahore head office on Walton Road (opposite Packages Mall Gate 2) and at G-04 Civic Center, Executive Block, Gulberg Greens, Islamabad, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm. Ask for a [free sample on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/923004617715) to check the colour in your bathroom light, then get a dated quote for your arabesque bathroom wall in Pakistan. Compare with the [peacock teal paseo mosaic](/products/glazed-color-peacock-teal-paseo-shape-ceramic-mosaic-bathroom-wall-tiles) or browse the [bathroom wall mosaic range](/categories/bathroom-wall-tiles-mosaic).

faqs.q: What is the price of arabesque mosaic tiles in Pakistan?
faqs.a: Pak Clay does not publish a fixed rate online. The price depends on the quantity, the area to cover and delivery to your city, so send your measurements on WhatsApp (+92 300 4617715) for a dated written quote.

faqs.q: Are arabesque tiles good for shower walls?
faqs.a: Glazed ceramic mosaic is commonly used on shower walls because the glaze is generally easy to wipe. The many grout joints matter most, so ask your tiler about waterproofing behind the tiles and a water-resistant grout.

faqs.q: Arabesque or fish scale mosaic: which should I choose?
faqs.a: Both are curved, decorative shapes. Arabesque gives an interlocking, woven look; fish scale gives overlapping rows like scales. Seeing both samples side by side on the wall usually settles it.

faqs.q: Can I see a sample before ordering?
faqs.a: Yes. Message Pak Clay on WhatsApp at +92 300 4617715 with "Small Arabesque Mosaic" and your city, or visit the Lahore showroom on Walton Road or the Islamabad location at G-04 Civic Center, Gulberg Greens, Monday to Saturday, 9 am to 9 pm.
